whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Pink Cuisine Cafe,

I noticed your cafe has fantastic 4.6★ reviews in Boring Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and menu browsing.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, specials menu, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/pinkcuisine

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke cafe (Pink Cuisine Cafe) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking and mobile-first menu showcase for Boring Road customers. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes aur actual photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
